research_gate.reason: Major Book System runtime must be checked against external research/standards before coding.

qualified_parent_foundation_preserved.rule: Research verification does not invalidate or transfer exact-SHA qualification. Qualified foundations are preserved and amended only through explicit versioned successor contracts where required.

current_parent_critical_path.objective: Forensically crosswalk existing Creative Excellence, Prose Project and Book Evaluator capabilities into professional structural-edit, stylistic/line-edit, copy-edit and post-layout-proofread responsibilities before creating any new capability; identify genuine gaps only after reuse/equivalence is proven.
must_produce: editorial stage to existing capability ownership matrix
no-duplicate-build decision for each editorial responsibility
successor requirements for publication/export standards profile and consistency regression
must_not_do: implement a new editor engine before the crosswalk
collapse structural, stylistic, copy editing and proofreading into one generic edit pass
route parent control to a child blocker merely because child work changed later
modify already-qualified exact-SHA evidence in place

generic_continue_rule: In Book System control, Continue executes BOOK-SYSTEM-EDITORIAL-CAPABILITY-CROSSWALK-001 until research remediation closes. It must not resume Integration Proposal Runtime implementation merely because that contract already exists.
research_before_implementation_rule: Major Book System architecture/capability additions require external research/standards verification before executable implementation, except strict repairs of already-qualified behavior with no capability expansion.
qualification_effect: Control-state advancement only. No new qualification, production, publication, author, human or manuscript-promotion authority is created by State-006.
